title: Plancherel identity on the sign cube
statement: For functions $f,g:\{-1,1\}^n\to\mathbb{R}$, their uniform inner product equals the sum, over all subsets $S\subseteq\{1,\ldots,n\}$, of the products of their Fourier coefficients: $\langle f,g\rangle=\sum_{S\subseteq\{1,\ldots,n\}}\widehat f(S)\widehat g(S)$.
